title: gregoria laevigata
intro: Gregoria laevigata, commonly known as the smooth Gregoria, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. The health benefits of Gregoria laevigata include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body.
